name: combined-100-lastline
description: Same 100 tasks as combined-100, graded with scope="last_line" on every answer-style task. Verbosity is not accuracy: thinking=off narrates, and grading the whole reply turned that into a fake accuracy gap. format-compliance tasks keep full scope because output shape is exactly what they measure.
